metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skills, starting with a verification toolkit.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Skills that give Claude evidence-based feedback loops: end-to-end verify skills, property and differential tests, diff-triggered reliability checks, and turning misses into rules.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Skills for reviewing code at agent volume while spending human attention where the risk is: REVIEW.md, a converging review loop, risk-based approval tiers, PR write-ups, reviewer evals, repo gates and code explainers.

plugins.name: critical-thinking
plugins.description: Skills for evaluating arguments, claims and decisions: critical questions for arguments, assumptions, evidence, rival causes and fallacies, plus judgment and decision tools against cognitive biases — bias checks, outside-view estimates, premortems, structured judgment, framing checks and self-critique.
